protocol.method_description: Whole-component multidimensional pipe-load ownership; retain original component order, reserve cross-component shared tensors across first/last-use component positions, greedily close a cohort before raw L1/UB envelope overflow, and merge only component sequence heads inside each cohort. Oversized singleton envelopes remain uncertified; no claim of zero official spill. No online scoring or tunable grid.
protocol.case_selection: Two fixed mechanism counterexamples from the preceding 24-cell pilot: 025 has many independent components and excess spill; 014 has cross-core fragmentation and shared inputs whose reserve can exceed L1 even for a singleton component. Both at 2/4/5 cores. No holdout/full-suite claim, no replacement.
protocol.failure_policy: Record every dispatched attempt, preserve exact failed plan/process evidence and no retry. Ordinary completed cell failures do not erase later predeclared cells; memory-limit or unresolved dispatch/observation failures stop further dispatch. No automatic resume of an existing output directory.
protocol.resources: One local worker, at most 4 GiB observed RSS. P1 previously authorized two-worker shared window; no exclusive timing claim. No Colab/GPU use. Scale and Windows runs remain with central s7c98 dispatcher.
protocol.offline_costs: Existing locked Python environment and official extraction reused. No training. Static 100-graph audits and proof calculations are reported separately; no per-case online plan or score table is consumed. Pro theory consultation remains in flight and is not code input.
protocol.comparison: Compare all six official outcomes to source dd9d8991/data81219bf9 direct pilot (same cases, cores, inputs/config/E0), fixed Fang contiguous and historical snapshot. In particular check whether extra DDR and spill decrease without sacrificing makespan. Both successful and negative/unsupported outcomes are published; construction count is one per cell.

timing.evaluation_precision: perf_counter seconds; ps observer and cleanup overhead included
